# T1 Everyone

Status: Draft for product-owner review (b10-design §7.2 item 1). Not delivered at any venue.

- Audience: All staff
- Runs it: VM
- Length: 15 minutes in the shift ([walkthrough](README.md#walkthrough))
- Practical task: Send one finding on a question from the venue's working list (B10-03 knowledge.working_list).

## Covers

- Signing in and leaving safely
- Home and To do
- Add
- What Saved for later means
- Couldn't establish
- My contributions on Me
- What happens after sending
- Capturing only when safe; no guests or private information in frame

## What the app says

- Only take photos when it's safe. Never while carrying hot food or using a knife.
- Overdue is shown for follow-up only: you can still send photos.
- Saved for later. Not sent yet. Finish it from Home or Me.
- Couldn't establish: You tried and couldn't find out.

## Not covered

- Monthly credit rules: explained from the staff guide on request, never restated on the card (no new credit claim).
